q1.question: Uburyo bw'kwizera bushoboka bukora biri mu buryo bwa?
q1.answer: Tutangira mu kiganiro c'ibisobanuro kugira ngo tumve ibyo ukeneye, ukurikije amasezerano y'ingendo.

q2.question: Ni gihe nakwakira ibyo nakoze?
q2.answer: Ibiringo riterewe n'ubunini. Urubuga ruto rufite ibyumirizo, amasezerano yakubye arufite amezi.

q3.question: Ikoranabuhanga iciyo ushokoresha?
q3.answer: Nakoresha React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL n'ibintu by'AI/ML.

q4.question: Wakoresha abakiriya bo mu isi yose?
q4.answer: Ego. Nakoresha abakiriya bo mu buryo bwose kandi mfite uburambe mu giheCitewe.

q5.question: Niba mpabaye guhindura nyuma yo gutuma?
q5.answer: Kazi cose gifite ibintu bisabwa. Nyuma, nfite amasezerano yo kwita no gukora.

q6.question: Ushobora gukora ibintu bikorana na AI?
q6.answer: Ego. Nafise uburambe mu machine learning, NLP, vision by'ibintu n'amasezerano y'AI nka OpenAI.
